short_description.text: Antipas — G-d's witness and faithful one (REV 2:13).
Jezebel — teaches and leads people astray (REV 2:20).
Death — the rider of the pale/ashen horse (REV 6:8).
Abaddon — king over the locusts of Revelation 9, the angel of the abyss (REV 9:11).
Armageddon is a place named in Scripture (Rev.16.16).
Babylon 3 is a place named in Scripture (Rev.14.8–Rev.18.21).
Patmos is a place named in Scripture (Rev.1.9).
Pergamum is a place named in Scripture (Rev.1.11–Rev.2.12).
Philadelphia is a place named in Scripture (Rev.1.11–Rev.3.7).
Sardis is a place named in Scripture (Rev.1.11–Rev.3.4).
Smyrna is a place named in Scripture (Rev.1.11–Rev.2.8).

who.text: God, Jesus, John, the churches, angels and the Lamb.

where.text: Patmos and visionary heaven and earth.

when.text: Commonly dated around AD 95 under Domitian, though an earlier date is proposed by some.

what.text: John receives visions of the risen Christ, letters to churches, cosmic judgment, the defeat of evil, and a new heaven and earth. Genre: Apocalyptic prophecy.

before.text: Concludes the New Testament with the consummation of the story.

stakes.text: Christ is victorious, evil is judged, and God dwells with his people.

immediate_summary.text: John receives visions of the risen Christ, letters to churches, cosmic judgment, the defeat of evil, and a new heaven and earth. Genre: Apocalyptic prophecy.
